svg.title: 2 · Spread one 8 + 4 stripe across twelve failure domains
svg.desc: Twelve failure-domain grids each contain one fragment from the highlighted stripe: eight data diamonds and four pink parity circles. Other squares belong to other stripes. If at most four domains are unavailable, at least eight fragments survive.
svg.text: 2 · Spread one 8 + 4 stripe across twelve failure domains
One fragment of this stripe per domain; a domain can be a host or a rack.
Lose at most four domains → at least eight fragments remain → the stripe is recoverable.
